description: The bundle cases of the decision test set (record 0019, 'The payload' and 'Compiling'): a payload, given as JSON (bundle) or as exact text (payload_text), and the verdict of the reference engine (cedar-policy): loaded, with the ids of the policies of the set, or refused, with the class and the id of the fault. expect_go, with gap, is the verdict of cedar-go where it differs: a known gap of that engine. The Go package and the Rust crate run every case.

cases.name: two policies

policies.admins: permit (principal in Group::"admins", action, resource == Route::"admin");

cases.name: every policy of the decision cases

policies.admins: permit (principal in Group::"admins", action, resource == Route::"admin");
policies.read: permit (principal, action in Action::"read", resource) when { resource.mode == "read" };
policies.no-post-on-read: forbid (principal, action == Action::"POST", resource) when { resource.mode == "read" };
policies.mail: permit (principal, action, resource == Route::"mail") when { principal.email like "*@example.com" };
policies.api: permit (principal, action, resource == Route::"api") when { context.path like "/api/*" && context.method == "GET" };
